/- Certificate 8990052ff4: Devoted Druid + Vizier of Remedies
   claim: Infinite mana   (grade A) -/
import Manaproof
open Manaproof

def cert : Cert := {
  cards := [(6, none), (7, none)],
  float := { life := 20 },
  pre := [],
  loop := [.act 0 0 {} 0 0 0, .act 0 1 {} 0 0 0] }

/-- The kernel re-executes the trace: the loop returns to the same board, richer. -/
theorem cert_ok : checkA Cards.db cert = true := by decide +kernel

/-- Net yield of one iteration. -/
theorem cert_delta : loopDelta Cards.db cert = some { g := 1 } := by decide +kernel

/-- Therefore the loop can be iterated any number of times. -/
theorem cert_unbounded :
    ∃ (s : State) (δ : Acc), δ ≠ Acc.zero ∧ run Cards.db (cert.init Cards.db) cert.pre = some s ∧
      ∀ n, run Cards.db (cert.init Cards.db) (cert.pre ++ rep n cert.loop)
        = some ⟨s.cfg, s.acc.add (Acc.smul n δ)⟩ :=
  checkA_sound Cards.db cert cert_ok
